title: Kenyan maternal-health chatbot routes urgent SMS questions directly to nurses
friendlyTitle: A pregnancy chatbot in Kenya sends urgent questions straight to nurses
summary: Jacaranda Health’s PROMPTS service handles about 15,000 daily pregnancy and newborn questions across 24 Kenyan counties using ordinary text messages. The system flags about 7% as potentially urgent and bypasses AI responses so a nurse can review the history and contact the patient.
friendlySummary: PROMPTS answers health questions by normal text message. When a message may be urgent, the AI steps aside and sends it to a nurse.
whyItMatters: The service pairs broad, low-cost access with a clear human escalation path instead of presenting AI as a clinician. Its SMS design also shows that useful AI services do not have to require a smartphone, app or constant internet connection.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This gives people with basic phones quicker access to help while keeping serious medical decisions with trained humans.
